analysis: Docs-only PR. hardware-support.md head 457-482 adds a 'Deadline admission rates' section and line 536 adds code-map entries. inference.md head 632-638 documents freshness anchoring of EnginePerformanceMeasurements.Rate to the newest observation. Head 882-918 documents three TTFT estimator corrections gated by DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES=0: per-step decode charging using CBv2DecodeRateShape, MTP depth mirroring, and an isolated-prefill anchor/floor from the startup calibration cell with a 30-minute idle expiry. Head 1780 updates a code-map row. The docs state these are time checks only. They change no KV grant, load quotation, activation floor, serving width or memory concurrency, and requests still pass slot/process byte admission (ProcessMemoryLedger, AdmissionV2). Published isolated rate, capacity wire fields and the platform memory contract are stated unchanged. Relevant threats: T-010/T-029 (DoS/resource) and T-041/SEC-035. A same-account TTFT oracle is unaffected because cache scoping and prefix-cache semantics are not touched. The documented looser decode pricing could admit more deadline-bound requests. However, memory admission remains authoritative per the docs, so availability impact is bounded to deadline misses rather than memory exhaustion. No source code is in this batch, so the actual implementation in AdmissionRateEstimators.swift and EngineV2Bridge+Admission.swift was not verified. Any integration pass should confirm that the env flag parsing defaults safely and that no wire field changed. No security regression or threat-model gap identified from the supplied evidence.
